points.notes: Re20 Cd2.04897 and Re200 mean Cd1.27052/Cl amplitude~0.569/St~0.186 from crossings are plausible; M080 shallow residual and M200 force drift remain.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All39 accepted sibling PDF pages visually reviewed; case residual/force/near-body fields and Re200 late force/wake/spectrum present. Some steady full-history force panels compress late behavior.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Accepted readable 39-page report contains case plots but report.tex:24 misstates full-traction integrated split as tangential; clean curated PDF build lacks escaped figure assets.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Matching workspace PDF/TeX and session-delivered figure manifest identify outputs; source be1f6b0 matches curated solver/src. Curated commit omits escaped PNG assets, and original binary cannot be independently rehashed.
